text: I can usually tell how someone is feeling just by looking at their face or body language.
When I feel a strong emotion, I can usually name exactly what I'm feeling and why.
I find it difficult to stay calm when someone criticizes me or disagrees with me.
I actively listen to people without interrupting or planning my response while they talk.
I can motivate myself to keep working toward a goal, even when I don't feel like it.
When a friend is upset, I genuinely feel their pain and want to support them.
I am good at adapting my communication style depending on who I'm talking to.
I sometimes react impulsively to emotions and later regret what I said or did.
I can navigate conflicts and disagreements without damaging my relationships.
I am aware of how my mood affects my behavior and the people around me.
I can calm myself down quickly after feeling anxious or angry.
I notice when someone is pretending to be okay but is actually struggling.
I find it easy to encourage and inspire others when they feel down or unmotivated.
I struggle to express my emotions verbally and often keep them bottled up.
I remain composed and effective even in high-pressure or emotionally charged situations.
I take time to reflect on why I reacted to a situation the way I did.
I can genuinely celebrate other people's success without feeling envious.
I am able to delay gratification and resist impulsive decisions when it matters.
I often misread social cues or situations and only realize it later.
I am comfortable discussing emotional topics openly with people I trust.
I am able to put myself in someone else's shoes even when their experience is very different from mine.
I notice shifts in group dynamics or tension in a room before others do.
I find it difficult to let go of grudges after being hurt by someone.
I actively check in with friends or colleagues to see how they are doing.
When facing a difficult emotional situation, I think through my options before reacting.
I recognize when stress from one area of my life is affecting my behavior in another.
I am good at finding common ground with people I strongly disagree with.
I find it easy to forgive people who have genuinely apologized for hurting me.
I often use humor or lightness to defuse emotionally tense situations.
I feel emotionally fulfilled by supporting others through difficult moments in their lives.
